title: Spirit of Holiness
definition: Spirit of Holiness is a biblical description of the Holy Spirit's holy nature and His work of making God's people holy.
summary: The Holy Spirit is holy and forms holiness in believers.
christFocus: Jesus is the Holy One, and the Spirit conforms believers to His holiness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit is not merely powerful; He is holy. His work is never to excuse sin, feed pride, or promote disorder. He forms the people of God in holiness.

The Spirit convicts, cleanses, renews desires, produces fruit, and strengthens obedience. He does not lead believers away from holiness but deeper into the likeness of Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people speak of the Spirit while tolerating sin or rejecting correction. This doctrine matters because the Spirit's true work produces Christlike purity and obedience.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Invite the Spirit to expose what is unholy and to form Christlike character in you. Do not grieve Him by clinging to sin.
